reference_review.redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and deterministic inputs. Python standard library only, in an isolated locked script environment, outside the product and ordinary CI; no upstream source is stored.
reference_review.limitations: Four observations and three coefficients, so the exact fit leaves no residual and gives no variance information; the posterior mean under a prior only approximates the contrast and the 0.08 band is a declared tolerance. The edge direction is inferred, not read from product code. No uncertainty or calibration claim.
